role.zh: Ineffable Intelligence 创始人；UCL 教授

why.en: Lead researcher on AlphaGo, AlphaZero and MuZero — the proof that self-play can exceed the ceiling of human knowledge. He left DeepMind to build a company on exactly that premise: superintelligence that learns without human data.
why.zh: AlphaGo、AlphaZero、MuZero 的首席研究员，证明了自我博弈可以超越人类知识上限。他离开 DeepMind，正是为了在这个前提上创立一家公司：不依赖人类数据学习的超级智能。

title.en: Welcome to the Era of Experience (with Richard Sutton)
title.zh: 欢迎来到经验的时代（与 Richard Sutton 合著）

note.en: Argues progress driven solely by supervised learning from human data is slowing, and a new approach is needed.
note.zh: 主张仅靠从人类数据监督学习驱动的进展正在放缓，需要新的路径。

title.en: DataRater: Meta-Learned Dataset Curation
title.zh: DataRater: Meta-Learned Dataset Curation

note.en: DataRater meta-learns which training data is worth keeping, replacing hand-tuned dataset mixtures.
note.zh: DataRater 用元学习判断哪些训练数据值得保留，替代人工调配的数据配比。

title.en: Is Human Data Enough? With David Silver
title.zh: Is Human Data Enough? With David Silver

note.en: DeepMind's own podcast, where he sets out the "era of experience" argument that agents must learn beyond the ceiling of human data.
note.zh: DeepMind 官方播客，他在其中阐述"经验时代"的主张：智能体必须突破人类数据的上限自行学习。

title.en: Gemini 1.5: Unlocking multimodal understanding across millions of tokens of context
title.zh: Gemini 1.5: Unlocking multimodal understanding across millions of tokens of context

note.en: He is a listed contributor to the Gemini 1.5 technical report, Google's long-context multimodal model family.
note.zh: 他是 Gemini 1.5 技术报告的署名贡献者，该模型是谷歌的长上下文多模态模型系列。

title.en: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
title.zh: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models

note.en: He is among the lead contributors listed on the original Gemini technical report.
note.zh: 他是初代 Gemini 技术报告靠前署名的核心贡献者之一。

title.en: Mastering the Game of Stratego with Model-Free Multiagent Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: Mastering the Game of Stratego with Model-Free Multiagent Reinforcement Learning

note.en: DeepNash reaches expert human level at Stratego, an imperfect-information game, using model-free multi-agent RL.
note.zh: DeepNash 用无模型多智能体强化学习，在不完全信息博弈 Stratego 上达到人类专家水平。

title.en: Self-Consistent Models and Values
title.zh: Self-Consistent Models and Values

note.en: Trains environment models and value functions to be self-consistent so planning improves rather than compounds error.
note.zh: 让环境模型与价值函数彼此自洽，使规划能真正提升表现而不是放大误差。

title.en: Bootstrapped Meta-Learning
title.zh: Bootstrapped Meta-Learning

note.en: Bootstrapped Meta-Learning overcomes the meta-optimisation bottleneck by having the meta-learner bootstrap its own target.
note.zh: Bootstrapped Meta-Learning 让元学习器自举生成目标，突破元优化的瓶颈。

title.en: The Option Keyboard: Combining Skills in Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: The Option Keyboard: Combining Skills in Reinforcement Learning

note.en: The Option Keyboard composes known skills into new ones for long-horizon reinforcement learning.
note.zh: Option Keyboard 通过组合已有技能生成新技能，服务于长时程强化学习。

title.en: Proper Value Equivalence
title.zh: Proper Value Equivalence

note.en: Generalises the value-equivalence principle to characterise which learned models are good enough for planning.
note.zh: 推广价值等价原理，刻画哪些学到的模型足以支撑规划。

title.en: Learning and Planning in Complex Action Spaces
title.zh: Learning and Planning in Complex Action Spaces

note.en: Sampled MuZero extends his planning-with-a-learned-model approach to high-dimensional and continuous action spaces.
note.zh: Sampled MuZero 把“用学到的模型做规划”推广到高维与连续动作空间。

title.en: Online and Offline Reinforcement Learning by Planning with a Learned Model
title.zh: Online and Offline Reinforcement Learning by Planning with a Learned Model

note.en: MuZero Reanalyse makes learned-model planning work in both online and offline, data-limited settings.
note.zh: MuZero Reanalyse 让基于学习模型的规划在在线与离线的低数据场景下同样可用。

title.en: Muesli: Combining Improvements in Policy Optimization
title.zh: Muesli: Combining Improvements in Policy Optimization

note.en: Muesli matches MuZero's performance with a policy update that folds model learning into an auxiliary loss instead of search.
note.zh: Muesli 用把模型学习作为辅助损失的策略更新，不依赖搜索也能达到 MuZero 的水平。

title.en: Discovery of Options via Meta-Learned Subgoals
title.zh: Discovery of Options via Meta-Learned Subgoals

note.en: Discovers temporal abstractions (options) automatically by meta-learning subgoals.
note.zh: 通过元学习子目标自动发现时间抽象（options）。

title.en: The Value Equivalence Principle for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: The Value Equivalence Principle for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Introduces the value-equivalence principle: models only need to be accurate where it matters for value prediction.
note.zh: 提出价值等价原理：环境模型只需在影响价值预测的方面准确即可。

title.en: Discovering Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
title.zh: Discovering Reinforcement Learning Algorithms

note.en: Meta-learns the RL update rule itself, automating the discovery of algorithms normally designed by hand.
note.zh: 直接元学习强化学习的更新规则本身，把原本靠人工设计的算法交给机器发现。

title.en: Meta-Gradient Reinforcement Learning with an Objective Discovered Online
title.zh: Meta-Gradient Reinforcement Learning with an Objective Discovered Online

note.en: Discovers the RL objective online via meta-gradients rather than fixing it in advance.
note.zh: 用元梯度在线发现强化学习的优化目标，而非预先固定。

title.en: Expected Eligibility Traces
title.zh: Expected Eligibility Traces

note.en: Expected eligibility traces improve credit assignment by propagating credit to states that could have led to an outcome.
note.zh: 期望资格迹把信用也分配给“本可能导致该结果”的状态，改进信用分配。

title.en: The Value-Improvement Path: Towards Better Representations for Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: The Value-Improvement Path: Towards Better Representations for Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Argues RL representations should be judged against the whole sequence of value functions an agent passes through, not one target.
note.zh: 主张强化学习的表征应服务于智能体经历的整条价值改进路径，而非单一目标。

title.en: #86 – David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: #86 – David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Lex Fridman interview on AlphaGo, AlphaZero and deep reinforcement learning, recorded while he led DeepMind's RL group.
note.zh: Lex Fridman 访谈，谈 AlphaGo、AlphaZero 与深度强化学习，录制于他领导 DeepMind 强化学习团队期间。

title.en: A Self-Tuning Actor-Critic Algorithm
title.zh: A Self-Tuning Actor-Critic Algorithm

note.en: A self-tuning actor-critic that adapts its own hyperparameters online via meta-gradients.
note.zh: 一种自调优 Actor-Critic 算法，通过元梯度在线自适应调整超参数。

title.en: Value-driven Hindsight Modelling
title.zh: Value-driven Hindsight Modelling

note.en: Uses hindsight information to learn what an agent should have predicted, improving value estimation.
note.zh: 利用事后信息学习“本该预测什么”，从而改进价值估计。

title.en: What Can Learned Intrinsic Rewards Capture?
title.zh: What Can Learned Intrinsic Rewards Capture?

note.en: Studies what learned intrinsic reward functions can encode beyond the external reward.
note.zh: 研究学到的内在奖励函数能够编码哪些外部奖励之外的信息。

title.en: Mastering Atari, Go, Chess and Shogi by Planning with a Learned Model
title.zh: Mastering Atari, Go, Chess and Shogi by Planning with a Learned Model

note.en: MuZero: mastering Atari, Go, chess and shogi by planning with a learned model, without being told the rules.
note.zh: MuZero：在不给定规则的情况下，用学到的模型进行规划，掌握 Atari、围棋、国际象棋与将棋。

title.en: Raises $1.1B for Ineffable Intelligence
title.zh: 为 Ineffable Intelligence 募资 11 亿美元

body.en: $1B at a $4B pre-money — among Europe's largest seed rounds ever. The stealth London startup aims at 'endlessly learning superintelligence' via reinforcement learning and world models, deliberately without human data.
body.zh: 10 亿美元、投前估值 40 亿美元，欧洲史上最大种子轮之一。这家伦敦隐身创业公司以强化学习与世界模型为路径，刻意不依赖人类数据，目标是「无止境学习的超级智能」。

title.en: Leaves Google DeepMind after a sabbatical
title.zh: 休假后离开 Google DeepMind

title.en: David Silver's Ineffable Intelligence names six cofounders from DeepMind, InstaDeep and Flying Fish
title.zh: David Silver's Ineffable Intelligence names six cofounders from DeepMind, InstaDeep and Flying Fish

body.en: Silver's new venture Ineffable Intelligence named six cofounders drawn from DeepMind, InstaDeep and Flying Fish, fleshing out the team behind his post-DeepMind superintelligence bet.
body.zh: 大卫·西尔弗的新公司Ineffable Intelligence公布了六位联合创始人，分别来自DeepMind、InstaDeep和Flying Fish，充实了他离开DeepMind后押注超级智能的团队。

title.en: AlphaGo architect David Silver leaves DeepMind to launch post-LLM AI startup
title.zh: AlphaGo architect David Silver leaves DeepMind to launch post-LLM AI startup

body.en: David Silver left DeepMind to found Ineffable Intelligence, a startup pursuing superintelligence through self-play rather than language models.
body.zh: David Silver离开DeepMind，创立Ineffable Intelligence，探索一条不依赖大语言模型、以自我对弈为核心的超级智能路线。

title.en: AlphaGo’s David Silver puts his superintelligence bet on Google Cloud
title.zh: AlphaGo’s David Silver puts his superintelligence bet on Google Cloud

body.en: His startup Ineffable Intelligence committed its compute to Google Cloud, setting the infrastructure base for its superintelligence effort.
body.zh: 他创办的 Ineffable Intelligence 选择 Google Cloud 作为算力基础，为其超级智能路线定下基础设施。

title.en: David Silver’s Ineffable Intelligence raises $1.1bn
title.zh: David Silver’s Ineffable Intelligence raises $1.1bn

body.en: Ineffable Intelligence, the company Silver founded after leaving DeepMind, raised $1.1bn to build models that learn without human data.
body.zh: Silver 离开 DeepMind 后创办的 Ineffable Intelligence 完成 11 亿美元融资，目标是训练无需人类数据即可学习的模型。

title.en: DeepMind’s David Silver Raises $1.1 Billion to Build AI That Learns Without Human Data
title.zh: DeepMind’s David Silver Raises $1.1 Billion to Build AI That Learns Without Human Data

body.en: He leaves DeepMind and raises $1.1B for a new company built on his long-standing bet that agents can learn beyond human data.
body.zh: 他离开 DeepMind，为新公司融资 11 亿美元，押注智能体可以在不依赖人类数据的情况下持续学习。

title.en: $1.1 Billion Bet on Autonomous Intelligence: David Silver Claims an AI that Teaches Itself
title.zh: $1.1 Billion Bet on Autonomous Intelligence: David Silver Claims an AI that Teaches Itself

body.en: Analytics Insight reported a $1.1 billion bet on Silver's startup Ineffable Intelligence, which is building AI systems that teach themselves without relying on human-generated data.
body.zh: Analytics Insight报道称，大卫·西尔弗创办的Ineffable Intelligence获得11亿美元投资，该公司致力于打造无需依赖人类生成数据即可自我学习的AI系统。

title.en: DeepMind’s David Silver just raised $1.1B to build an AI that learns without human data
title.zh: DeepMind’s David Silver just raised $1.1B to build an AI that learns without human data

body.en: He raised $1.1B at a $5.1B valuation for Ineffable Intelligence, backed by Sequoia and Nvidia, to build AI that learns without human data.
body.zh: 他为 Ineffable Intelligence 融资 11 亿美元、估值 51 亿美元，红杉与英伟达参投，目标是造出无需人类数据即可学习的 AI。

title.en: Ex-DeepMind star David Silver raises $1.1B at $5.1B valuation for AI "superlearner" startup
title.zh: Ex-DeepMind star David Silver raises $1.1B at $5.1B valuation for AI "superlearner" startup

body.en: Silver's startup raised $1.1B at a $5.1B valuation to build a self-play-based 'superlearner' AI, a major funding milestone.
body.zh: Silver的创业公司以51亿美元估值完成11亿美元融资，用于打造基于自我对弈的「超级学习者」AI，是一项重大融资进展。

was.en: Head of RL, Google DeepMind; Professor, UCL
was.zh: Google DeepMind 强化学习负责人；UCL 教授
